learningObjectives: Understand how trained ML models are exposed to applications
Identify the components of an ML prediction API
Trace a request from client input to model prediction

activities.title: ML API Architecture
activities.instruction: Build the components of a model prediction service.

content.concept: An ML API connects clients to a deployed model through request handling, validation, prediction, and response generation.

activities.title: API Request Anatomy
activities.instruction: Click each request component to identify its role.

content.concept: An API request commonly contains an endpoint, method, headers, and input data required by the service.

activities.title: Prediction Request Flow
activities.instruction: Arrange the journey from client request to model response.

content.concept: A prediction API receives input, validates it, invokes the model, and returns a structured result.

activities.title: Deployment Component Match
activities.instruction: Match each deployment component with its responsibility.

content.concept: Deployment systems combine application servers, model artifacts, dependencies, and infrastructure to serve predictions.
